items.title: Pacers undermanned and outplayed in Miami to open NBA Cup play
items.body_excerpt: Yes, that’s a gross NBA Cup court. And Braden Smith scoring his first NBA point. (Photo: DAZN) The Pacers were shorthanded on Friday, in Miami for their first NBA Cup game.
